THE COMPANIES ACT, 2017 (XIX of 2017)
(Company Limited by Shares)
ARTICLES OF ASSOCIATION
OF
DUBIZZLE LABS (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED
INTERPRETATION
1. The Regulations as set out in part II of Table A of First Schedule of the Companies Act, 2017 (the “Act”)
shall be the regulations of Dubizzle Labs (SMC-Private) Limited (the “Company”)
SINGLE MEMBER COMPANY
The Company is a single member company and as such being a private company limited by
shares—
it shall not invite the public to subscribe for any shares of the Company;
(a)
(b)

the Company shall not register any share(s) in the name of two or more persons to
hold one or more shares jointly; and

(c)

number of the members of the Company shall be limited to one.
SHARES

The company may alter its share capital in accordance with section 85 of the Act.
Share certificate shall be issued under the seal of the Company and shall be signed by the
member director or the non-member director, as the case may be.
DIRECTOR(S)
5. The Company shall always have the sole member or in case it is not a natural person its nominee, as
a director but it may have such number of other director(s) who fulfil the conditions as specified in
section 153 of the Act. MR. IMRAN ALI KHAN (nominee director of ZAMEEN
DEVELOPMENTS (PRIVATE) LIMTIED) shall be the first directro of the Company.
